items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: which, you know, was always a friend of mine. I had known Coleman since about 1926. And Coleman -- well, we lived around the corner from eachother.

ctx.x: I seem to remember somebody else coming from Saint, Joe, Missouri.

Well, I'll tell you, Jesse Stone had a band there before, and they were the Blue Serenaders. This is the first band Coleman Hawkins ever played in, with Jesse Stone. Coleman Hawkins is from Saint, Joseph, Missouri. And his whole family, and all of them play the piano, and were beautiful musicians, his whole family.
But where was Jesse Stone really from?

items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Instead of Egghead, you know, we called him the Bean, you know.

ctx.x: Because he was so intelligent about music and the way he could play and the way he could think and the way his chord progressions run, we'd call him the Bean. Instead of Egghead, you know, we called him the Bean, you know.
Like Egghead, that's how he got that name.
